Title: Data Scientist – Python & Cloud Data Platforms (f/m/x)
Description:
We’re looking for data scientists who turn ambiguous business questions into models and analyses that actually get used. You’ll frame the problem, wrangle the data, build and validate models, and — just as importantly — explain what the numbers mean to people who don’t speak Python. Your day-to-day will revolve around the classic Python data stack: pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn.

You’ll also work on modern enterprise data platforms — running notebooks and lakehouse workloads in Microsoft Fabric, building pipelines and operational applications in Palantir Foundry, and deploying analytics on Azure, AWS, or GCP. The science matters, but so does making it work inside a real organization’s data ecosystem.

What We Offer

AI Grant — Stop talking about AI and start building it. Our AI Grant gives you dedicated budget and resources to turn your wildest AI idea into a working project, backed by two paid weeks to focus on nothing else.

AI Center of Excellence — Work alongside specialists in agentic AI, sovereign AI, generative and discriminative AI. This isn’t a siloed team — it’s the people you’ll learn from and build with daily.

Your tools, your choice — Full access to AI-powered development tools including Claude, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot. Pick what works best for you.

Real project variety — From generative AI for legal document compliance through agentic systems in manufacturing environments to enterprise-scale AI platforms, computer vision, and autonomous driving. You won’t get bored.

Conference and speaking support — Want to attend conferences? We’ll back you. Want to speak at them? Even better — we’ll support you with dedicated preparation time and bonuses.

Your tasks


Translate business problems into analytical solutions: define hypotheses, choose metrics, and select the right modeling approach for the question at hand
Explore, clean, and prepare data using Python (pandas, NumPy), working with structured and semi-structured sources of varying quality
Build, validate, and tune machine learning models for classification, regression, forecasting, segmentation, and recommendation using scikit-learn, XGBoost, and statsmodels
Design and analyze experiments: A/B tests, statistical hypothesis testing, and causal analysis that hold up to scrutiny
Work hands-on with enterprise data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric (lakehouses, notebooks, semantic models) and Palantir Foundry (pipelines, ontology, operational workflows)
Communicate findings through clear visualizations, dashboards, and narratives tailored to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike
Collaborate with data engineers on data availability and quality, and with ML/AI engineers to move models from notebook to production
Monitor deployed models for drift and degradation, and own the retraining and improvement cycle


Requirements


At least 4 years in data science or applied analytics, with models and analyses that made it past the prototype stage
Strong Python skills across the standard data stack (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn)
Solid statistical foundations: hypothesis testing, regression, experimental design, and knowing when a result is real versus noise
Knowledge of at least one cloud/data platform and its data science components — Azure (Microsoft Fabric, Azure Machine Learning), AWS (SageMaker), GCP (Vertex AI, BigQuery ML), Snowflake (Snowpark ML, Cortex), Databricks (MLflow, Mosaic AI), or Palantir (Foundry Code Workspaces, Foundry ML, AIP)
Ability to communicate analytical results clearly to business stakeholders and influence decisions with data
Familiarity with working autonomously while collaborating effectively with data engineers, architects, and product teams
Fluent English, both written and spoken
Fluent Polish required
Residing in Poland required


Nice to have


Production experience with Microsoft Fabric or Palantir Foundry certification (Foundry Data Engineer / Data Scientist tracks)
Experience with time series forecasting, NLP, recommender systems, or exposure to LLM-based workflows
Familiarity with MLOps practices: MLflow, experiment tracking, model versioning, and CI/CD for ML
Experience with Power BI or other BI tools, and distributed processing with Spark/PySpark

Continental is a leading tire manufacturer and industry specialist that develops and produces sustainable, safe and convenient solutions for automotive manufacturers as well as industrial and end customers worldwide. Founded in 1871, the company generated sales of €19.7 billion in 2025 and currently employs around 78,000 people in 54 countries and markets.

In Digital Solutions, we drive innovation for connected mobility and deliver cutting-edge digital products to our global fleet customers. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will be at the forefront of transforming data into intelligent, scalable solutions.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Bracco is an international Group active in the healthcare sector and a leader in diagnostic imaging. The Group’s main products are contrast agents sold in over 100 countries, both directly and indirectly through branches, joint ventures and license and distribution agreements.




About the Role

We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our Digital Transformation Office and help turn data into scalable business impact. The Data Scientist designs and deploys machine learning and advanced analytics solutions that create measurable business impact. In this role, you will work across business and technical teams to develop data-driven solutions, improve decision-making, and support key transformation initiatives.




Key responsibilities

Design, develop, and optimize machine learning and advanced analytics solutions for business use cases
Explore, clean, and structure data from multiple sources, including CRM, internal pipelines, and cloud platforms
Build, validate, and monitor predictive models and analytical workflows
Translate business needs into data science approaches, hypotheses, and measurable outcomes
Collaborate with data engineers, domain experts, and business stakeholders to industrialize solutions
Communicate insights and model outputs through clear visualizations, presentations, and recommendations
Support deployment, documentation, and continuous improvement of models and pipelines
Contribute to the adoption of data science best practices across the organization




What we are looking for

1 to 3 years of experience in data science, advanced analytics, or similar roles
Strong hands-on experience with Python and SQL
Experience with machine learning techniques such as regression, classification, clustering, forecasting, or anomaly detection
Familiarity with Databricks or similar cloud-based data and analytics environments
Good understanding of model validation, performance monitoring, and reproducible workflows
Ability to work effectively across technical and business teams
Strong communication skills and ability to explain complex outputs to non-technical stakeholders




Preferred qualifications

Experience with ML pipelines, MLOps, or model deployment workflows
Knowledge of statistics and experimental design
Experience with visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau
Exposure to pharmaceutical, healthcare, or regulated environments is a plus




Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.




Why join the DTO

You will work on high-impact transformation initiatives and help shape the company's AI and analytics journey by building solutions that move from idea to business adoption.




Employment terms

The role is classified at Level C under the National Collective Agreement for the Chemical-Pharmaceutical Industry (CCNL Chimico-Farmaceutico).

The guaranteed minimum base annual gross salary established by the CCNL for the applicable level is € 36.556,24.

The overall compensation will be determined based on the experience, skills, and qualifications of the selected candidate.




If you meet the requirements of this opportunity and would like to join an international group working to improve patients' lives, apply now!

At Bracco, we believe in the values of diversity and inclusion. We respect and celebrate the diversity of our people and their experiences, ensuring a fair opportunity for all.

Title: Data Scientist – Scoring Center (M/F)
Description:
Present in more than 30 countries, BNP Paribas Personal Finance leads the personal and consumer credit business. In some markets we are leaders, and we bet on innovation to open up new opportunities, in others we are a fast growing business. In all markets, we value relationships, knowledge sharing and responsible action

In practice, your day-to-day


As a Data Scientist in the Scoring Center team, you will undertake projects to build risk prediction models. Your main responsibilities will be:
As part of your modelling projects, you assess the needs expressed, define and propose the adapted deliverables and estimate their burden and time frame through an implementation plan that takes into account the challenges and constraints. You use statistical modelling methods (such as Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting…), analyze and explain the results
You lead the project, keep track of the schedule and support the implementation and monitoring of the tools issued
As part of the monitoring and optimization of the BNP Paribas Personal Finance score models, you participate in the monitoring campaigns of the scores: generation and analysis of monitoring results, diagnosis and action plan
You are also responsible for conducting or analyzing statistical studies related to risk prediction models. If necessary, you take part in analytical support missions to the Group's international entities and in the processing of audit recommendations relating to the Basel regulatory project
In addition, you actively contribute to the transversal missions of the Scoring Center: technological and methodological watch, regulatory watch, training, analytical support for the Group's international entities

The Mission is important, but so is the Team and the workplace!


Welcome to BNP Paribas Personal Finance, where you will integrate the Analytics Hub, an innovative, international and creative team. Our working language is English
You will be in the Scoring Center teams that are made up of 30 Data Scientists that will work with you. The team in Lisbon is new and everyone is growing together. You'll be surrounded by colleagues working in the same field as you, sharing ideas and experiences
We are prepared to welcome you with an initial onboarding plan, with on-the-job training, online learning and networking opportunities


What do we have to offer you?


This is a very important topic that we will address together, taking into account your training and experience.


Are you the one we are looking for?


Do you have a Degree in Data Science, Mathematics or Statistics?
Do you have a scientific background and at least 3 years of experience in a statistical or risk environment, preferably modelling in banking or insurance environment?"
Do you have good skills in Python?
Are you proficient in modelling environment or data lab and have a strong knowledge of the main data science libraries?
Do you have experience in machine models industrialization?
Are you able to work on several projects in parallel and are acknowledge for your accuracy?
Are you fluent in oral and written English?
If you recognize yourself in this description, and have a lot of enthusiasm, energy and motivation, then you are the one we are looking for!
We look forward to your application!


Our commitments


BNP Paribas is an equal opportunity employer that is proud to provide equal employment opportunities to all job seekers. As a socially responsible company, we incorporate the principles of Diversity and Inclusion in our values and practices
To achieve all our goals, we intend to attract, develop, and retain different profiles, assuming diversity as an enabler and differentiator of innovation, fundamental in our organization

Description:
Information sur l'entreprise

La délégation à la transformation et à la performance ministérielles (DTPM) assure, pour le compte du secrétaire général pour l'administration (SGA), la mission générale de modernisation de l'administration du ministère. Elle concentre à cet effet ses actions sur trois axes complémentaires, le conseil, le numérique et l'innovation et intervient, selon le cas, sur différents périmètres, ministériel, fonctionnel ou organique, aussi bien pour mettre en œuvre des actions relevant d'une administration centrale classique que d'une administration de mission.

La DTPM est forte de près de cent trente agents, répartis en trois départements : une agence ministérielle de conseil (AMC), un nouveau service de transformation numérique (STN) et un département du management et de la transformation interne (DMTI). Le centre d’expertise données et intelligence artificielle (CEDIA) du SGA est rattaché au sein du STN. Le centre est chargé de contribuer au domaine de l’intelligence artificielle organique de défense plus précisément le périmètre administration et soutien. Il est un des acteurs clé du domaine IA au sein du ministère.




Description

Le Data Scientist Confirmé intègre l’équipe en tant que référent technique/ scientifique, il est chargé d’accompagner les juniors dans leur montée en compétences tout en participant à la réalisation des projets data 360 et IA. Il est également en charge de l’utilisation des technologies Big Data et IA, dans le but d’aider à la prise de décision et faire de la veille technologique sur les architectures Big Data et IA

Vous aurez la responsabilité de :

• Analyser des données pour traduire une problématique métier en problème mathématique statistique, et réciproquement

• Anticiper avantages/inconvénients de différents modèles ou méthodes calcul dans environnement métier après comparaison et évaluation de ces modèles

• Apporter expertise pour exploration/analyse complexe de données au moyen techniques variées : statistiques, analyse texte, comportementale, images

• Caractériser des données (qualité, richesse, contenu) en vue de leur intégration dans le système d'information cible du métier et créer des algorithmes de recherche de données permettant d'explorer les données utiles

• Produire des rapports et des représentations graphiques à partir des données pertinentes afin de synthétiser et traduire des informations pour faciliter la prise de décision




Profil

Ingénieur diplômé d’une école spécialisée (ENSAE, ENSAI, Polytechnique…) ou d’un master en data science, vous justifiez de 5 ans d’expérience sur un poste similaire.

Vous êtes doté de solides compétences techniques autour de Python et packages adaptés, Docker, Git.

Vous avez également de très bonnes capacités interpersonnelles et de communication dans le travail quotidien.

Title: Senior Data Scientist, Varallisuudenhoidon Wealth Channels heimo
Description:
Haemme kokenutta ja näkemyksellistä Data Scientistia vakituiseen tehtävään Helsinkiin osaksi Varallisuudenhoidon Wealth Channels heimon Data & AI and Experience -joukkuetta.

Data Scientistina pääset osana rakentamaan OP Varallisuudenhoidon tulevaisuutta Wealth Channels-heimossa kehittämällä personoituja, datalähtöisiä ja tekoälyavusteisia palveluita. Työskentelet ainutlaatuisen asiakas- ja käyttäytymisdatan parissa ja pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten suomalaiset säästävät, sijoittavat ja tekevät taloudellisia päätöksiä tulevaisuudessa.

Vastaat asiakaskäyttäytymisen analysoinnista ja ennakoinnista, personointimallien kehittämisestä sekä uusien AI-pohjaisten palveluiden suunnittelusta ja käyttöönotosta. Pääset viemään analytiikan havaintoja konkreettisiksi palveluiksi ja ominaisuuksiksi sekä vaikuttamaan sekä liiketoiminnan että asiakaskokemuksen kehittymiseen.

Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden työskennellä datan, tekoälyn, asiakaskokemuksen ja digitaalisen liiketoiminnan rajapinnassa. Työsi ei rajoitu vain raportteihin tai mallien rakentamiseen, vaan pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, millaisia palveluita asiakkaamme käyttävät ja miten ne kehittyvät tulevaisuudessa.

Tehtävästä

Päävastuullasi on toteuttaa osana liiketoimintaa valittuja käyttötapauksia eri varallisuudenhoidon prosesseihin liittyen Wealth Channels-heimon suuntaviivojen mukaisesti. Fokuksessasi tulevat olemaan mm. seuraavia asioita


Personoidut sisällöt ja näkymät asiakkaille digikanavissa
Personoidut ja oikea-aikaiset asiakasviestit
Asiakaskäyttäytymisen ennakointi
Tuotesuosittelu


Kaikkinensa tavoitteena on tuottaa kehittyvän datapohjan päälle mahdollisimman käyttökelpoisia ratkaisuja, joilla voidaan tukea varallisuudenhoidon strategisia kasvutavoitteita.

Työskentelet modernissa pilviympäristössä (Azure/Databricks) hyödyntäen Python-ekosysteemiä (mm. PySpark, Pandas). Vastaat yhteistyössä muiden olennaisten roolien, kuten business leadien, Product Ownerien ja sidosryhmien asiantuntijoiden kanssa kokonaisuuksien suunnittelusta, mallinnuksesta sekä analytiikan määrittelystä. Senior -roolissa sinulla on vapaus ja vastuu ohjata teknistä toteutusta sekä varmistaa, että ratkaisut ovat paitsi sääntelyn mukaisia, myös tilastollisesti kestäviä ja liiketoimintaa aidosti hyödyttäviä.

Pääset osallistumaan myös muihin analytiikkapohjaisten ratkaisujen suunnitteluihin, kuten varallisuudenhoidon uusien järjestelmien omien AI-kyvykkyyksien arviointiin sekä suunnittelemaan ja toteuttamaan varallisuudenhoidon alueen koneoppimista ja tekoälyä hyödyntäviä hankkeita.

Työssäsi esittelet analyysejäsi sidosryhmille ja kykenet perustelemaan valitut ratkaisut ymmärrettävästi. Lisäksi pääset osallistumaan varallisuudenhoidon Data Scientist -alueen suunnitteluun ja kasvattamiseen sekä liiketoiminnan osaamisen kehittämiseen.

Tehtävä sijaitsee Helsingin Vallilan toimistollamme, ja kuten muuallakin OP Pohjolassa, yhdistämme arjessamme lähi- ja etätyöskentelyä.

Millaista osaamista etsimme?

Jotta menestyisit tässä strategisessa ja teknisessä roolissa, toivomme sinulta seuraavia 

Vahva tekninen ja menetelmällinen osaaminen 


hallitset data-analytiikan ja mallinnuksen Python-ekosysteemissä (Python, PySpark, Pandas) 
sinulla on vahva kokemus tilastollisista menetelmistä ja koneoppimisesta
Databricks, SQL ja pilvipalveluosaaminen (erityisesti Azure) ovat keskeisessä roolissa 
näytät esimerkkiä AIn hyödyntämisestä arjessa ja osaat hahmottaa sen mahdollisuudet liiketoiminnassa 


Strateginen ote ja yhteistyötaidot 


kykenet ottamaan kokonaisvastuun järjestelmän toimivuudesta ja kehityssuunnasta
osaat muotoilla liiketoiminnan tarpeet tekniseksi toteutukseksi ja toisaalta perustella tekniset ratkaisut ymmärrettävästi liiketoimintajohdolle
olet oma-aloitteinen ratkaisija, joka uskaltaa ottaa vastuuta ja viedä asioita maaliin


Liiketoimintaosaaminen 

Hyödyksi on, jos sinulla on jo valmiiksi ymmärrystä tai suuri into syventää osaamista varallisuudenhoidosta, pitäen sisällään mm. varainhoidon, rahastoliiketoiminnan, arvopaperikaupankäynnin ja sijoitussidonnaisen henkivakuuttamisen.

Tärkeintä on kuitenkin kyky soveltaa syvällistä data- ja mallinnusosaamista liiketoiminnan ongelmien ratkaisuun. 

Miksi OP Pohjola?

Meillä on käytössä ns. 70-20-10 -periaate, mikä tarkoittaa, että käytät 70% ajastasi päivittäisiin tehtäviin, 20% työskentelytapojen hiomiseen ja viimeiset 10% vapaasti uusien taitojen oppimiseen. Tämän osuuden voit käyttää esimerkiksi meidän omassa OP Tech Academyssa, jossa voit laajentaa osaamistasi monella eri osa-alueella. Kyllä, voit siis laajentaa osaamistasi työajalla!

Koska elämä on paljon muutakin kuin työtä, meille on ensisijaisen tärkeää, että henkilöstömme voi hyvin. Pidämme arvossa työn ja vapaa-ajan tasapainoa. Saat myös käyttöösi monipuoliset henkilöstöetumme, johon kuuluvat henkilöstörahasto sekä henkilökuntaehtoiset pankki-, vakuutus- ja lainapalvelut. Tarjoamme myös kattavan työterveyshuollon, laajan hoitokuluvakuutuksen sekä täysajan tapaturmavakuutuksen. Työssäjaksamiseen panostamme arjen tasapainolla ja joustavuudella sekä tarjoamalla käyttöösi lounas-, liikunta- ja kulttuuriedut sekä mahdollisuuden edulliseen lomailuun OP Pohjolan lomaosakkeissa.

Lisätiedot ja hakuohjeet

Hae tehtävää lähettämällä meille CVsi ja vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta viimeistään su 20.9.2026. Kuulemme mielellämme lisää osaamisestasi ja motivaatiostasi tätä tehtävää kohtaan.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä voit kysyä liiketoiminnan edustajalta Mikko Virkkuselta (puh.nro 050 466 7662 / mail. mikko.virkkunen(at)op.fi) tai rekrytoivalta esihenkilöltäsi Sirppa Niemiseltä (sirppa.nieminen(at)op.fi).

Finanssialalla luottamus ja vastuullisuus ovat toimintamme perusta, minkä vuoksi tehtävään valittavalta henkilöltä tarkistetaan luottotiedot, yritysyhteydet ja mahdolliset eturistiriidat, teetetään huumausainetesti sekä Suojelupoliisin teettämä perusmuotoinen turvallisuusselvitys.

OP Pohjola – Meillä on jotain yhteistä

OP Pohjola on monimuotoisuutta ja yhdenvertaisuutta kunnioittava työyhteisö. Meille on tärkeää, että jokainen tuntee olonsa tervetulleeksi ja arvostetuksi. Arvostamme erilaisuuden mukanaan tuomaa rikkautta ja monipuolisia näkökulmia. Kannustamme kaikkia hakemaan meille töihin, sillä meillä on jotain yhteistä. Hienoa, että haluat mukaan yhteiselle matkallemme.

Olemme asiakkaidemme omistama, finanssialan vetovoimaisin työnantaja Suomessa. Meillä työskentelee yli 14 000 alan ammattilaista. Perustehtävämme on edistää omistaja-asiakkaidemme ja toimintaympäristömme kestävää taloudellista menestystä, turvallisuutta ja hyvinvointia. Meillä työskentely on merkityksellistä sekä työntekijöillemme että muille, sillä Suomen suurimpana finanssitoimijana rakennamme työllämme toiveikkaampaa tulevaisuutta. Sitä olemme tehneet jo yli 120 vuoden ajan.

Title: Senior Data Scientist ID70128
Description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to develop predictive models and quantitative analytics that power risk-based vulnerability prioritization within a large-scale enterprise security program. You will structure and analyze massive security telemetry datasets, build ML algorithms to eliminate scanning noise and false positives, and establish unified data dashboards to drive adoption of data-driven security governance. The role requires 5+ years of data science experience with direct commercial application to vulnerability management, operating with full autonomy.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Develop predictive models and quantitative analytics to prioritize vulnerabilities based on contextual risk and business impact;
- Structure and analyze massive outputs of security data from across the enterprise ecosystem to support the ASPM framework;
- Create machine learning algorithms or statistical models to automatically identify and filter out scanning noise and false positives;
- Establish a unified data delivery structure and dashboards to drive the adoption of data-driven security governance.

MUST HAVES
- 5+ years of commercial data science experience, operating completely autonomously with no required supervision;
- Advanced proficiency in Python, R, and SQL;
- Experience with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch;
- Experience with data visualization tools;
- Commercial experience applying data science to vulnerability management;
- Upper-intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES
- Familiarity with Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) data outputs (e.g., Wiz).

PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation: USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.

Title: Senior Data Scientist (m/w/d)
Description:
Dein Profil


Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in den Bereichen Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Physik, Mathematik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
Du hast mindestens 3-5 Jahre praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Data Science oder verwandten Feldern
Du bist sicher in der Aufbereitung, Analyse, Manipulation sowie Visualisierung von Daten und verfügst über Programmierkenntnisse (Python) und Erfahrung mit SQL
Du verfügst über ein exzellentes Verständnis von Graph- und Machine-Learning-Algorithmen (Random Forests, Boosting, Support Vector Machines, Neural Networks, Deep Learning), sowie von mathematischer Modellierung (Statistik, Zeitreihenanalyse, Netzwerkanalyse, usw.) und hast praktische Erfahrung mit relevanten Bibliotheken (z.B. scikit-learn, TensorFlow/Keras, PyTorch, JAX, XGBoost)
Deine hohe Eigeninitiative, Teamfähigkeit und sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse zeichnen dich aus


Deine Aufgaben


Du betreust unsere Kunden bei ihren Datenprojekten – von der Konzeption bis hin zur Implementierung
Du analysierst, visualisierst und interpretierst komplexe Daten, um relevante Erkenntnisse zu identifizieren
Du bist verantwortlich für die Gewährleistung der Datenqualität durch effektive Datenaufbereitung/-manipulation (Pandas, NumPy), Datenvisualisierung (Tableau, Matplotlib, Seaborn), sowie der Verarbeitung verschiedener Datenformate (Tabellen, Bilder, Text, Graphen)
Du entwirfst und implementierst Machine-Learning-Modelle zur Lösung komplexer Probleme, wobei du geeignete Algorithmen auswählst und anpasst
Du arbeitest eng mit deinem Team zusammen und coachst dabei jüngere Teammitglieder

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Technology at Primark

Our technology team is actively shaping the next wave of advancements. Engaged with innovative initiatives, your expertise will propel our business into the future. Collaborating with a creative team of tech enthusiasts, you’ll contribute your unique skills to fuel our technological advancements.

We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to join Primark’s Data Science & Measurement team, delivering advanced analytics, machine learning and experimentation solutions that drive measurable business value. Working with stakeholders across key business functions, you will solve complex commercial challenges using data science and statistical techniques. This is a hands-on role for an experienced data scientist with strong technical expertise, commercial awareness and a passion for turning data into actionable business outcomes.

What You'll Do


Advanced Analytics & Machine Learning Delivery: Lead the design, development and deployment of machine learning, optimisation and measurement solutions that solve complex business challenges and deliver measurable commercial value.
Data Science Product Development: Build and maintain scalable data science products, including predictive models, forecasting solutions, segmentation, recommendation engines and experimentation frameworks that support business decision-making.
Data Engineering & Model Productionisation: Develop robust analytical datasets and machine learning pipelines using Databricks, Python, SQL and Spark, ensuring solutions are scalable, reliable and production-ready.
Stakeholder Partnership & Commercial Impact: Partner with business stakeholders to define hypotheses, success measures and value metrics, translating analytical insights into actionable recommendations that improve commercial outcomes.
Experimentation & Measurement Leadership: Lead experimentation, testing and measurement initiatives, using statistical methods and causal inference techniques to evaluate business performance and impact.
Technical Leadership & Team Development: Mentor Data Scientists and Analysts, sharing best practices across modelling, experimentation, coding standards and commercial problem solving.
Data Science Strategy & Innovation: Contribute to the data science roadmap, champion best practices and develop innovative retail-focused solutions across areas such as pricing, forecasting, customer behaviour and operational efficiency.


What You'll Bring


Advanced Data Science Experience (5-8 Years): Strong hands-on experience delivering machine learning, statistical modelling, optimisation and advanced analytics solutions within commercial environments.
Python, SQL & Data Platform Expertise: Advanced Python and SQL skills, with experience building reproducible machine learning workflows using Databricks, Spark or similar large-scale data processing technologies.
Machine Learning & Statistical Expertise: Deep understanding of supervised and unsupervised machine learning, feature engineering, model evaluation, experimentation and performance monitoring techniques.
Retail & Commercial Analytics: Experience applying data science in retail, consumer, grocery, apparel or other high-volume environments, delivering solutions that support business performance and decision-making.
Experimentation & Value Measurement: Experience designing, executing and interpreting experiments, measurement frameworks and analytical initiatives that deliver measurable business value.
Stakeholder Engagement & Communication: Ability to translate business challenges into analytical solutions and communicate complex findings through clear, compelling recommendations.
Leadership & Continuous Improvement: Experience mentoring colleagues, driving best practices and contributing to the growth, innovation and maturity of a high-performing Data Science function.


About Primark

At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to a £9bn+ turnover business and over 80,000 colleagues and over 440 stores in 17 countries today. Our values run through everything we do. In essence, we're Caring and always strive to put people first. We're also Dynamic, bravely pushing the boundaries to stay ahead. And finally, we succeed Together.

Title: Senior Data Scientist (Remote Friendly)
Description:
Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

As a Senior Data Scientist at Docplanner, you will help transform complex data into actionable insights and scalable machine learning solutions that directly impact business growth and operational excellence. You will work on high-impact initiatives across Business, Operations, and Product areas, partnering closely with business stakeholders, engineers, and analytics teams.

You will own data science and BI projects end-to-end - from problem definition and experimentation to model deployment and monitoring - using large-scale datasets and ML infrastructure. We are looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with business understanding and a pragmatic, impact-driven mindset.

This role is part of our Global Data department, supporting data and AI initiatives across Docplanner’s international operations.

How would you be impacting our mission?


Own and deliver end-to-end data science and BI projects, from exploration and experimentation to deployment in production.
Build predictive models and machine learning solutions that support business decision-making and operational efficiency.
Analyze large datasets to uncover actionable insights, trends, and growth opportunities.
Design and evaluate experiments and A/B tests to measure impact and validate hypotheses.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Engineering.
Improve and maintain scalable data pipelines and ML workflows together with Data & ML engineering teams.
Use modern AI tools, copilots, and AI agents to automate workflows, accelerate experimentation, and improve productivity.
Contribute to best practices in model development, testing, deployment, and documentation.


What will help you thrive?


5+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or Advanced Analytics roles.
Strong Python skills and hands-on experience with libraries such as Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
Solid understanding of statistics, experimentation, machine learning, and model evaluation techniques.
Experience working with large datasets, SQL, and data warehouses such as Redshift, BigQuery, or Snowflake.
Familiarity with MLOps and modern development practices (Git, Docker, MLflow, CI/CD).
Experience using AI-powered tools or AI agents to improve efficiency and automate repetitive tasks.
Strong communication skills and ability to translate business needs into practical technical solutions.
Comfortable working in agile, fast-paced, and cross-functional environments.


Bonus points


Experience with Airflow, k8s, Jupyter Notebook, Athena, or other big data technologies.
Experience with NLP, LLMs, or AI agent workflows.
Familiarity with BI and visualization tools such as Tableau or Superset.
Previous experience in SaaS or high-growth tech environments.


What To Expect From Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣ Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Partner Giuliana to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2️⃣Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with Wiktor, Business Intelligence Manager and your potential manager in this role. Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

3️⃣Business Case – A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings.

4️⃣Final Interview – A final conversation with one of your main stakeholder from our Global Team.

5️⃣ References & Offer!

Why You’ll Love It Here

💙 Global Benefits – No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:


Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.


📍 Local Perks – Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

🚀 Career Growth – We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

🌎 A Truly Global Team – Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

⏳ Flexibility That Works for You – Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

📊 Focus on results – we're here to make an impact.

🧠 Think like an owner – take responsibility, drive outcomes.

✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean – smart solutions over complexity.

🔊 Be respectful and radically honest – openness builds trust.

📚 Learn and be curious – growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

As a Senior Data Scientist at Docplanner, you will help transform complex data into actionable insights and scalable machine learning solutions that directly impact business growth and operational excellence. You will work on high-impact initiatives across Business, Operations, and Product areas, partnering closely with business stakeholders, engineers, and analytics teams.

You will own data science and BI projects end-to-end - from problem definition and experimentation to model deployment and monitoring - using large-scale datasets and ML infrastructure. We are looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with business understanding and a pragmatic, impact-driven mindset.

This role is part of our Global Data department, supporting data and AI initiatives across Docplanner’s international operations.

How would you be impacting our mission?

  • Own and deliver end-to-end data science and BI projects, from exploration and experimentation to deployment in production.
  • Build predictive models and machine learning solutions that support business decision-making and operational efficiency.
  • Analyze large datasets to uncover actionable insights, trends, and growth opportunities.
  • Design and evaluate experiments and A/B tests to measure impact and validate hypotheses.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Engineering.
  • Improve and maintain scalable data pipelines and ML workflows together with Data & ML engineering teams.
  • Use modern AI tools, copilots, and AI agents to automate workflows, accelerate experimentation, and improve productivity.
  • Contribute to best practices in model development, testing, deployment, and documentation.

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or Advanced Analytics roles.
  • Strong Python skills and hands-on experience with libraries such as Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.

  • Experience with Airflow, k8s, Jupyter Notebook, Athena, or other big data technologies.

Bonne compréhension de la qualité des données, de la performance des modèles et du monitoring.

Title: Senior Data Scientist (m/w/d)
Description:
Dein Profil


Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in den Bereichen Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Physik, Mathematik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
Du hast mindestens 3-5 Jahre praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Data Science oder verwandten Feldern
Du bist sicher in der Aufbereitung, Analyse, Manipulation sowie Visualisierung von Daten und verfügst über Programmierkenntnisse (Python) und Erfahrung mit SQL
Du verfügst über ein exzellentes Verständnis von Graph- und Machine-Learning-Algorithmen (Random Forests, Boosting, Support Vector Machines, Neural Networks, Deep Learning), sowie von mathematischer Modellierung (Statistik, Zeitreihenanalyse, Netzwerkanalyse, usw.) und hast praktische Erfahrung mit relevanten Bibliotheken (z.B. scikit-learn, TensorFlow/Keras, PyTorch, JAX, XGBoost)
Deine hohe Eigeninitiative, Teamfähigkeit und sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse zeichnen dich aus


Deine Aufgaben


Du betreust unsere Kunden bei ihren Datenprojekten – von der Konzeption bis hin zur Implementierung
Du analysierst, visualisierst und interpretierst komplexe Daten, um relevante Erkenntnisse zu identifizieren
Du bist verantwortlich für die Gewährleistung der Datenqualität durch effektive Datenaufbereitung/-manipulation (Pandas, NumPy), Datenvisualisierung (Tableau, Matplotlib, Seaborn), sowie der Verarbeitung verschiedener Datenformate (Tabellen, Bilder, Text, Graphen)
Du entwirfst und implementierst Machine-Learning-Modelle zur Lösung komplexer Probleme, wobei du geeignete Algorithmen auswählst und anpasst
Du arbeitest eng mit deinem Team zusammen und coachst dabei jüngere Teammitglieder

Title: Científico de datos
Description:
Data Scientist (Machine Learning & AWS)




En Akkodis, combinamos soluciones digitales y de ingeniería para crear un futuro más inteligente para todos. Con presencia en más de 30 países de Europa, Asia y América, apostamos por la innovación, aprovechando la experiencia de nuestros equipos y la tecnología para transformar industrias y dar respuesta a los desafíos más complejos del mundo.

Actualmente estamos ampliando nuestro equipo y buscamos un/a Data Scientist para incorporarse a un proyecto con grandes oportunidades de desarrollo profesional. Como Data Scientist, desempeñarás un papel clave en el diseño e implementación de soluciones analíticas avanzadas que transformen los datos en iniciativas de negocio con impacto real.




¿Cuál será tu misión?

Te integrarás en un equipo especializado en analítica de datos dentro del sector bancario, participando en el diseño, desarrollo y evolución de soluciones analíticas orientadas a mejorar la toma de decisiones y la personalización de productos.

Trabajarás en la construcción de modelos de Machine Learning, modelos predictivos y sistemas de recomendación, participando en todo el ciclo de vida de las soluciones, desde la definición funcional hasta su despliegue y mantenimiento.




¿Qué harás en tu día a día?

🔹 Diseñar, desarrollar e implementar soluciones de Machine Learning end-to-end.

🔹 Desarrollar, evolucionar y optimizar modelos de recomendación y modelos predictivos orientados al negocio.

🔹 Analizar, transformar y explotar grandes volúmenes de datos utilizando Python, PySpark y SQL.

🔹 Trabajar en entornos Cloud sobre AWS, especialmente con Amazon SageMaker.

🔹 Colaborar con equipos de negocio y tecnología para traducir necesidades funcionales en soluciones analíticas de alto valor.

🔹 Participar en todas las fases del ciclo de desarrollo: análisis, diseño, implementación, pruebas y mantenimiento.

🔹 Garantizar la calidad, escalabilidad y robustez de las soluciones desarrolladas.




¿Qué buscamos?

✅ Entre 3,5 y 5 años de experiencia como Data Scientist.

✅ Formación universitaria en disciplinas STEM, preferentemente:

Física
Matemáticas
Ingeniería Informática
Ingeniería Aeroespacial

✅ Experiencia demostrable trabajando con:

Python
PySpark
SQL

✅ Experiencia en entornos AWS, especialmente con Amazon SageMaker.

✅ Experiencia en diseño, desarrollo, despliegue y mantenimiento de modelos de Machine Learning.

✅ Capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma cubriendo el ciclo completo de desarrollo de soluciones analíticas.

✅ Perfil analítico, proactivo y orientado a resultados.

✅ Capacidad para trabajar en entornos colaborativos y multidisciplinares.




Valoraremos especialmente

✔ Experiencia en modelos de recomendación.

✔ Experiencia en modelos predictivos orientados al negocio.

✔ Conocimiento del sector bancario o financiero.

✔ Participación en proyectos de analítica avanzada con impacto en negocio.




¿Qué ofrecemos?

📃 Contrato indefinido.

🏠 Modelo híbrido de trabajo (2 días presenciales por semana en Madrid).

🌍 Participación en un proyecto estratégico dentro de una de las principales entidades del sector bancario.

🚀 Entorno tecnológico innovador con foco en Data, Machine Learning y Cloud AWS.

📚 Formación continua y acceso a planes de desarrollo profesional.

💸 Beneficios sociales y descuentos exclusivos para empleados/as de Akkodis.

Title: Data Science
Description:
Desde HAYS estamos colaborando con una consultora española especializada en Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Inteligencia Artificial y transformación basada en datos. Acompaña a organizaciones de distintos sectores en la construcción de soluciones avanzadas basadas en datos, ayudándolas a convertir la información en ventajas competitivas y mejoras de negocio.




Actualmente buscamos incorporar un/a Data Scientist para participar en un proyecto de gran impacto dentro del sector retail, enfocado en modelos predictivos de previsión de demanda y optimización de procesos de planificación.

Trabajarás con grandes volúmenes de información y contribuirás a transformar los datos en decisiones estratégicas mediante técnicas avanzadas de Machine Learning, Deep Learning y modelización estadística.




Principales responsabilidades

Desarrollar modelos de forecasting para previsión de demanda utilizando técnicas estadísticas, Machine Learning y Deep Learning.
Construir y optimizar modelos de series temporales mediante algoritmos como ARIMA, SARIMA, XGBoost, LightGBM, LSTM y arquitecturas basadas en Transformers.
Trabajar con estructuras de datos jerárquicas y multinivel, gestionando diferentes niveles de granularidad.
Diseñar estrategias de feature engineering incorporando variables relacionadas con promociones, precios, estacionalidades, elasticidades, rupturas de stock y canibalización de productos.
Analizar grandes volúmenes de datos e identificar patrones que permitan mejorar la planificación y la toma de decisiones.
Implementar metodologías robustas de validación mediante backtesting y monitorización continua de resultados.
Definir y controlar métricas de rendimiento predictivo como MAPE, WMAPE y RMSE.
Desarrollar soluciones escalables utilizando Python y SQL.
Participar en la puesta en producción, monitorización y mejora continua de modelos analíticos.




Qué necesitarás

Data Science y Machine Learning aplicado a forecasting y predicción de demanda.
Desarrollo de modelos de series temporales.
Programación avanzada con Python y SQL.
Tratamiento y análisis de grandes volúmenes de datos.
Técnicas de validación y evaluación de modelos predictivos.
Conocimientos sólidos de estadística aplicada y analítica avanzada.
Nivel de inglés B2 o superior.




Qué ofrecemos

Incorporación a un proyecto estratégico con tecnologías punteras de analítica avanzada e inteligencia artificial.
Participación en iniciativas de alto impacto dentro de entornos data-driven.
Trabajo en un entorno altamente especializado y colaborativo.
Modelo de trabajo híbrido con gran flexibilidad y únicamente un día presencial a la semana.
Contrato indefinido.
Proyección profesional y crecimiento dentro de proyectos innovadores de Data & AI.

Are you ready to embark on this journey with us?

Design, develop, and deploy advanced models, including classical machine learning, deep learning, and algorithmic solutions, to solve complex business problems.

Promote best practices in Data Science by optimizing workflows and expanding the DS/ML toolbox with tools that enhance model accuracy, runtime, and maintainability.
Strengthen our technical infrastructure by integrating modern technologies that enhance efficiency, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
Drive innovation by evaluating and integrating emerging ML/AI methodologies, including LLMs, to enhance model performance.
Translate complex model results into actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Share expertise through knowledge sharing and sparring sessions.
Proactively identify potential data science applications for value creation.
Contribute to branch development initiatives and long-term planning, including roadmap definition.


Fuel for your success in the role

We Imagine You Have


Master’s degree in a data science-related field (e.g., computer science, cognitive science, IT, mathematics/statistics, economics).
Advanced Python programming skills.
Proficient in Data Science skills including classical machine learning for tabular data, ML frameworks (scikit-learn, deep learning frameworks), data wrangling, data analysis, and visualization.
Experienced with the following technologies: SQL, Web APIs, Git, Linux commands.
Excellent English communication skills with the ability to present complex data clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Show genuine care for both team dynamics and the success of the organization, fostering a positive and inclusive work culture.


Preferred Qualifications


Prior working experience in applying data science, with a focus on machine learning and predictive modeling.
Familiarity with the following technologies: MLOps, Spark, Cloud platform (e.g. Azure/AWS), mlflow, ETL processes, CI/CD processes.
Databricks environment for building and deploying ML models.
Leveraging LLMs for enhancing the performance of ML models through prompt engineering and embeddings.

Title: Senior Data Scientist ID70128
Description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to develop predictive models and quantitative analytics that power risk-based vulnerability prioritization within a large-scale enterprise security program. You will structure and analyze massive security telemetry datasets, build ML algorithms to eliminate scanning noise and false positives, and establish unified data dashboards to drive adoption of data-driven security governance. The role requires 5+ years of data science experience with direct commercial application to vulnerability management, operating with full autonomy.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Develop predictive models and quantitative analytics to prioritize vulnerabilities based on contextual risk and business impact;
- Structure and analyze massive outputs of security data from across the enterprise ecosystem to support the ASPM framework;
- Create machine learning algorithms or statistical models to automatically identify and filter out scanning noise and false positives;
- Establish a unified data delivery structure and dashboards to drive the adoption of data-driven security governance.

MUST HAVES
- 5+ years of commercial data science experience, operating completely autonomously with no required supervision;
- Advanced proficiency in Python, R, and SQL;
- Experience with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch;
- Experience with data visualization tools;
- Commercial experience applying data science to vulnerability management;
- Upper-intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES
- Familiarity with Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) data outputs (e.g., Wiz).

PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation: USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
- Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
- Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options.

Meet Our Recruitment Process
Application → Coding Challenge → Video Interview → Technical Interview or Hiring Manager Interview
Each step helps us understand your skills and overall fit.
If it’s a match, you’ll receive an offer.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to play a key role in advancing our physiological feature pipeline and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible with biomarker and wearable health data. This role is ideal for an experienced ML expert who has expertise around health data, thrives in ambiguous problem spaces, and brings a balance of hands-on technical depth and strategic thinking.

You will work within our Product Science team, and we seek a data scientist who thrives in dynamic environments and is prepared to pioneer in uncharted territory accompanied with a creative approach to algorithmic development.

Location: Finland, we have offices in Helsinki and Oulu

What You Will Do


Contribute to development of new human physiology based features and new sensor technology
Transform multi-sensor data into actionable health metrics by combining insights from diverse biosensing technologies with state-of-the-art data science methodologies
Develop reusable data analytics tools, which can be deployed at scale
Actively participate in developing and refining the team’s strategic roadmap, innovating and prioritising initiatives, and aligning project goals with broader organisational objectives
Lead data collections, write scientific reports, publications and white papers, and present findings internally (leadership and stakeholders) and externally (conferences, etc.)
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and overseas stakeholders


We would love to have you on our team if you have:


Have 6+ years of experience in Data Science with sparse real world data, most likely wearable data with excellent physiological understanding
Considers Python as their Mother Tongue and has a strong track record in developing deep learning and multimodal data fusion for sequential data.
Experience with forecasting models, optimization models, statistical analysis, and running simulations.
Have an advanced degree (Masters/Doctor) in a STEM-related field (e.g. engineering, computer science, mathematics, statistics) or equivalent work experience
Expert level experience building and deploying data science products using AWS tools, SQL, GitHub, and Pytorch
Strong project management experience and is comfortable working with a diverse, distributed and talented group of team members
Excellent written and verbal communication skills to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
Demonstrates a proactive mindset, thriving in uncharted territories with the resilience and creativity to navigate ambiguity and deliver solutions in the face of obstacles


What We Offer


Competitive Salary
Lunch benefit
Wellness benefit
Flexible working hours
Collaborative, smart teammates
An Oura ring of your own


If this sounds like the next step for you, please send us your application as soon as possible.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
¡Hola! Somos OGA




Nos ilusiona que estés considerando esta oportunidad de empleo.




Somos una compañía pionera en la hibridación de la Inteligencia Artificial y la Investigación Operativa, con sede en Sevilla. Nuestro objetivo es transformar la industria a través de soluciones innovadoras y de alto impacto para nuestros clientes, líderes en sectores como el logístico, supply chain, industrial o el químico.




Esto lo conseguimos gracias al talento de nuestro equipo, que incluye a matemáticos/as, estadísticos/as o desarrolladores/as de software, entre otros, y a la confianza de grandes clientes. Además, mantenemos una estrecha colaboración con la Universidad a través de nuestro Consejo Asesor Tecnológico, Grupo CÁTEDRA, compuesto por 14 catedráticos de renombre nacional e internacional, especializados en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos, y con el que reforzamos nuestra propuesta y valor científico.




Sobre la posición.




Buscamos un/a Senior Data Scientist con experiencia en la investigación, análisis y modelado de datos para identificar patrones y tendencias clave, impulsando la toma de decisiones estratégicas en la organización, para unirse a nuestro equipo.




¿Qué harás?





Análisis de datos y desarrollo de aplicaciones de optimización de procesos complejos con técnicas tanto de Inteligencia Artificial como de Investigación Operativa, utilizando entre otros, lenguajes de programación como Python, Java, JavaScript o C++.


Analizar, depurar, transformar, visualizar, etc. los datos disponibles para proyectos de IA, utilizando las herramientas y tecnologías necesarias en cada caso concreto.


Realizar el EDA (Exploratory Data Analysis) de los datos para proporcionar un buen conjunto de datos a los modelos de IA.


Utilización de diferentes modelos de Machine Learning y Deep Learning, los cuales serán entrenados, validados y testados en función de los objetivos de cada proyecto.


Tuning de modelos ML/DL.


Investigación e implementación de algoritmos y herramientas de ML/DL.


Implementación del pipeline completo de un modelo de ML/DL (Datasource, Limpieza datos, Ingeniería de Variables, Entrenamientos, Validación, Puesta en producción y Monitorización/Operación).


Analizarás bases de datos utilizando técnicas de análisis estadístico avanzado.


Desarrollarás soluciones y modelos avanzados de Inteligencia Artificial.


Elaborarás documentación técnica relacionada con los proyectos.





Timing de primeras semanas en OGA




Desde tu primer día, estarás acompañado/a por todo el equipo. El área de People organizará una serie de reuniones de Onboarding en tres niveles con distintos responsables de OGA: aspectos generales y sistemas internos, el propósito de la compañía y las tecnologías que utilizamos. También conocerás a tu Buddy, quien te guiará, especialmente en tu primer mes, durante todo el proceso de integración. Junto a tu Buddy, tendrás reuniones programadas para abordar cualquier tema que facilite tu adaptación.




¿Qué requerimos?





Titulación en Máster en Matemáticas / Estadística / Ingeniería / Ciencias de la Computación o área relacionada (valorable Doctorado).


Experiencia de más de 5 años en el sector de Inteligencia Artificial, incluyendo al menos 3 años como consultor senior liderando proyectos complejos y horizontales con exposición al negocio, con experiencia en tratamiento de datos (captura, almacenamiento, normalización, limpieza, visualización, ETLs y modelos de datos) e implementación de soluciones de IA utilizando Machine Learning y Deep Learning, aplicando algoritmos supervisados, no supervisados y auto-explicativos, como RandomForest, CatBoost, XGBoost, CNN y RNN.


Conocimiento y dominio experto en Python (valorable experiencia en otras plataformas y lenguajes), conocimientos recomendables en bases de datos como Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL y MS SQL/SQL Azure, así como experiencia en el entorno de desarrollo de Microsoft Azure. Nivel Alto de inglés.





¿Qué valoramos?





Airflow, Hadoop, Spark, MongoDB.


Interés por el desarrollo de una carrera técnica y vocación por la especiación tecnológica.


Pasión por la tecnología y por la creación de valor para el cliente.


Capacidad de relación con equipos de negocio y funcionales, visión holística del problema de negocio a resolver.


Orientación a resultados, proactividad, trabajo en equipo.


Disponibilidad para viajar a nivel nacional e internacional de manera esporádica.





¿Qué te ofrecemos?





Un entorno de trabajo dinámico y flexible, con proyectos y clientes tecnológicamente retadores en nuestra oficina de Sevilla.


Formar parte de un equipo apasionado por los datos y la innovación tecnológica, con perfiles senior y junior, de las áreas de las matemáticas, estadística, ciencia de datos o desarrollo de software, entre otras.


Colaboración permanente con el Grupo CÁTEDRA, el Consejo Asesor Tecnológico de OGA, compuesto por 14 catedráticos de renombre nacional e internacional especializados en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos.


Acceso a diversas herramientas de IA Generativa, que nos ayudan a acelerar tiempos de entrega, aumentar capacidad productiva, minimizar desgastes y sobrecargas, y en definitiva maximizar la eficiencia y rentabilidad de OGA.


Sesión de onboarding con responsables de OGA y de People, en la que te entregaremos tu kit de bienvenida.


Participación en eventos corporativos donde podrás conocer e interactuar con el resto del equipo de una forma distendida y divertida.


Asistencia al congreso anual del Grupo CÁTEDRA en Sevilla, donde se presentan los últimos avances y proyectos en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos, con una completa agenda científica, formativa y de debate.


Plan de formación continua. En OGA, la formación continua es un valor clave y un pilar de nuestro compromiso con el desarrollo personal y profesional. Nos inspiramos en el concepto de ikigai, buscando que cada persona encuentre aquello que le motive y le permita crecer dentro de la organización. Por eso, te propondremos acciones formativas que consideremos valiosas para tu crecimiento. Sin embargo, serás tú quien debe tomar la iniciativa en tu propio desarrollo, identificando aquello que te apasiona y proponiendo a tu responsable las formaciones que desees realizar. Juntos evaluareis su viabilidad, su aporte de valor y su alineación con la estrategia de OGA.


Compromiso con la inclusión y la diversidad. En OGA nos tomamos muy en serio el talento. Creemos que cada persona aporta algo único y especial, por lo que es parte de nuestro compromiso ofrecer un ambiente donde todos podáis brillar.


Beneficios sociales y profesionales integrados en un plan global de conciliación. Como ‘entidad familiarmente responsable’ - efr - desde 2015, certificada por la Fundación Másfamilia, en OGA hemos desarrollado un amplio catálogo de beneficios para tu bienestar personal y profesional.





¡Únete a nosotros!




Si te entusiasma nuestra visión innovadora y estás listo/a para enfrentar desafíos diarios con empresas líderes, ¡queremos conocerte! Aplica ahora y únete a OGA para seguir creando soluciones increíbles y de gran impacto.




Por supuesto, si durante el proceso de selección necesitaras algún tipo de asistencia, simplemente avísanos. Nuestro equipo de People te ayudará para asegurarnos de que todo vaya sobre ruedas y tengas una experiencia genial.




¡Te esperamos!

Buscamos un/a Senior Data Scientist con experiencia en la investigación, análisis y modelado de datos para identificar patrones y tendencias clave, impulsando la toma de decisiones estratégicas en la organización, para unirse a nuestro equipo.


¿Qué harás?



  • Análisis de datos y desarrollo de aplicaciones de optimización de procesos complejos con técnicas tanto de Inteligencia Artificial como de Investigación Operativa, utilizando entre otros, lenguajes de programación como Python, Java, JavaScript o C++.

  • Analizar, depurar, transformar, visualizar, etc. los datos disponibles para proyectos de IA, utilizando las herramientas y tecnologías necesarias en cada caso concreto.

  • Realizar el EDA (Exploratory Data Analysis) de los datos para proporcionar un buen conjunto de datos a los modelos de IA.

  • Utilización de diferentes modelos de Machine Learning y Deep Learning, los cuales serán entrenados, validados y testados en función de los objetivos de cada proyecto.

  • Tuning de modelos ML/DL.

  • Investigación e implementación de algoritmos y herramientas de ML/DL.

  • Implementación del pipeline completo de un modelo de ML/DL (Datasource, Limpieza datos, Ingeniería de Variables, Entrenamientos, Validación, Puesta en producción y Monitorización/Operación).

  • Analizarás bases de datos utilizando técnicas de análisis estadístico avanzado.

  • Desarrollarás soluciones y modelos avanzados de Inteligencia Artificial.

  • Elaborarás documentación técnica relacionada con los proyectos.


Timing de primeras semanas en OGA


Desde tu primer día, estarás acompañado/a por todo el equipo. El área de People organizará una serie de reuniones de Onboarding en tres niveles con distintos responsables de OGA: aspectos generales y sistemas internos, el propósito de la compañía y las tecnologías que utilizamos. También conocerás a tu Buddy, quien te guiará, especialmente en tu primer mes, durante todo el proceso de integración. ¿Qué requerimos?



  • Titulación en Máster en Matemáticas / Estadística / Ingeniería / Ciencias de la Computación o área relacionada (valorable Doctorado).

  • Experiencia de más de 5 años en el sector de Inteligencia Artificial, incluyendo al menos 3 años como consultor senior liderando proyectos complejos y horizontales con exposición al negocio, con experiencia en tratamiento de datos (captura, almacenamiento, normalización, limpieza, visualización, ETLs y modelos de datos) e implementación de soluciones de IA utilizando Machine Learning y Deep Learning, aplicando algoritmos supervisados, no supervisados y auto-explicativos, como RandomForest, CatBoost, XGBoost, CNN y RNN.

  • Conocimiento y dominio experto en Python (valorable experiencia en otras plataformas y lenguajes), conocimientos recomendables en bases de datos como Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL y MS SQL/SQL Azure, así como experiencia en el entorno de desarrollo de Microsoft Azure. Nivel Alto de inglés.


¿Qué valoramos?



  • Airflow, Hadoop, Spark, MongoDB.

  • Interés por el desarrollo de una carrera técnica y vocación por la especiación tecnológica.

  • Pasión por la tecnología y por la creación de valor para el cliente.

  • Capacidad de relación con equipos de negocio y funcionales, visión holística del problema de negocio a resolver.

  • Orientación a resultados, proactividad, trabajo en equipo.

  • Disponibilidad para viajar a nivel nacional e internacional de manera esporádica.


¿Qué te ofrecemos?



  • Un entorno de trabajo dinámico y flexible, con proyectos y clientes tecnológicamente retadores en nuestra oficina de Sevilla.

  • Formar parte de un equipo apasionado por los datos y la innovación tecnológica, con perfiles senior y junior, de las áreas de las matemáticas, estadística, ciencia de datos o desarrollo de software, entre otras.

  • Colaboración permanente con el Grupo CÁTEDRA, el Consejo Asesor Tecnológico de OGA, compuesto por 14 catedráticos de renombre nacional e internacional especializados en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos.

  • Acceso a diversas herramientas de IA Generativa, que nos ayudan a acelerar tiempos de entrega, aumentar capacidad productiva, minimizar desgastes y sobrecargas, y en definitiva maximizar la eficiencia y rentabilidad de OGA.

  • Sesión de onboarding con responsables de OGA y de People, en la que te entregaremos tu kit de bienvenida.

  • Participación en eventos corporativos donde podrás conocer e interactuar con el resto del equipo de una forma distendida y divertida.

  • Asistencia al congreso anual del Grupo CÁTEDRA en Sevilla, donde se presentan los últimos avances y proyectos en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos, con una completa agenda científica, formativa y de debate.

  • Plan de formación continua. En OGA, la formación continua es un valor clave y un pilar de nuestro compromiso con el desarrollo personal y profesional. Nos inspiramos en el concepto de ikigai, buscando que cada persona encuentre aquello que le motive y le permita crecer dentro de la organización. Por eso, te propondremos acciones formativas que consideremos valiosas para tu crecimiento. Sin embargo, serás tú quien debe tomar la iniciativa en tu propio desarrollo, identificando aquello que te apasiona y proponiendo a tu responsable las formaciones que desees realizar. Juntos evaluareis su viabilidad, su aporte de valor y su alineación con la estrategia de OGA.

  • Compromiso con la inclusión y la diversidad. En OGA nos tomamos muy en serio el talento. Creemos que cada persona aporta algo único y especial, por lo que es parte de nuestro compromiso ofrecer un ambiente donde todos podáis brillar.

  • Beneficios sociales y profesionales integrados en un plan global de conciliación. Como ‘entidad familiarmente responsable’ - efr - desde 2015, certificada por la Fundación Másfamilia, en OGA hemos desarrollado un amplio catálogo de beneficios para tu bienestar personal y profesional.


¡Únete a nosotros!


Si te entusiasma nuestra visión innovadora y estás listo/a para enfrentar desafíos diarios con empresas líderes, ¡queremos conocerte! Aplica ahora y únete a OGA para seguir creando soluciones increíbles y de gran impacto.


Por supuesto, si durante el proceso de selección necesitaras algún tipo de asistencia, simplemente avísanos. Nuestro equipo de People te ayudará para asegurarnos de que todo vaya sobre ruedas y tengas una experiencia genial.


¡Te esperamos!

Title: Data scientist confirmé F/H
Company: Commissariat au Numérique de Défense - CND
Description:
Information sur l'entreprise

La délégation à la transformation et à la performance ministérielles (DTPM) assure, pour le compte du secrétaire général pour l'administration (SGA), la mission générale de modernisation de l'administration du ministère. Elle concentre à cet effet ses actions sur trois axes complémentaires, le conseil, le numérique et l'innovation et intervient, selon le cas, sur différents périmètres, ministériel, fonctionnel ou organique, aussi bien pour mettre en œuvre des actions relevant d'une administration centrale classique que d'une administration de mission.

La DTPM est forte de près de cent trente agents, répartis en trois départements : une agence ministérielle de conseil (AMC), un nouveau service de transformation numérique (STN) et un département du management et de la transformation interne (DMTI). Le centre d’expertise données et intelligence artificielle (CEDIA) du SGA est rattaché au sein du STN. Le centre est chargé de contribuer au domaine de l’intelligence artificielle organique de défense plus précisément le périmètre administration et soutien. Il est un des acteurs clé du domaine IA au sein du ministère.




Description

Le Data Scientist Confirmé intègre l’équipe en tant que référent technique/ scientifique, il est chargé d’accompagner les juniors dans leur montée en compétences tout en participant à la réalisation des projets data 360 et IA. Il est également en charge de l’utilisation des technologies Big Data et IA, dans le but d’aider à la prise de décision et faire de la veille technologique sur les architectures Big Data et IA

Vous aurez la responsabilité de :

• Analyser des données pour traduire une problématique métier en problème mathématique statistique, et réciproquement

• Anticiper avantages/inconvénients de différents modèles ou méthodes calcul dans environnement métier après comparaison et évaluation de ces modèles

• Apporter expertise pour exploration/analyse complexe de données au moyen techniques variées : statistiques, analyse texte, comportementale, images

• Caractériser des données (qualité, richesse, contenu) en vue de leur intégration dans le système d'information cible du métier et créer des algorithmes de recherche de données permettant d'explorer les données utiles

• Produire des rapports et des représentations graphiques à partir des données pertinentes afin de synthétiser et traduire des informations pour faciliter la prise de décision




Profil

Ingénieur diplômé d’une école spécialisée (ENSAE, ENSAI, Polytechnique…) ou d’un master en data science, vous justifiez de 5 ans d’expérience sur un poste similaire.

Vous êtes doté de solides compétences techniques autour de Python et packages adaptés, Docker, Git.

Vous avez également de très bonnes capacités interpersonnelles et de communication dans le travail quotidien.

Title: Data Scientist – Python & Cloud Data Platforms (f/m/x)
Description:
We’re looking for data scientists who turn ambiguous business questions into models and analyses that actually get used. You’ll frame the problem, wrangle the data, build and validate models, and — just as importantly — explain what the numbers mean to people who don’t speak Python. Your day-to-day will revolve around the classic Python data stack: pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn.

You’ll also work on modern enterprise data platforms — running notebooks and lakehouse workloads in Microsoft Fabric, building pipelines and operational applications in Palantir Foundry, and deploying analytics on Azure, AWS, or GCP. The science matters, but so does making it work inside a real organization’s data ecosystem.

What We Offer

AI Grant — Stop talking about AI and start building it. Our AI Grant gives you dedicated budget and resources to turn your wildest AI idea into a working project, backed by two paid weeks to focus on nothing else.

AI Center of Excellence — Work alongside specialists in agentic AI, sovereign AI, generative and discriminative AI. This isn’t a siloed team — it’s the people you’ll learn from and build with daily.

Your tools, your choice — Full access to AI-powered development tools including Claude, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot. Pick what works best for you.

Real project variety — From generative AI for legal document compliance through agentic systems in manufacturing environments to enterprise-scale AI platforms, computer vision, and autonomous driving. You won’t get bored.

Conference and speaking support — Want to attend conferences? We’ll back you. Want to speak at them? Even better — we’ll support you with dedicated preparation time and bonuses.

Your tasks


Translate business problems into analytical solutions: define hypotheses, choose metrics, and select the right modeling approach for the question at hand
Explore, clean, and prepare data using Python (pandas, NumPy), working with structured and semi-structured sources of varying quality
Build, validate, and tune machine learning models for classification, regression, forecasting, segmentation, and recommendation using scikit-learn, XGBoost, and statsmodels
Design and analyze experiments: A/B tests, statistical hypothesis testing, and causal analysis that hold up to scrutiny
Work hands-on with enterprise data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric (lakehouses, notebooks, semantic models) and Palantir Foundry (pipelines, ontology, operational workflows)
Communicate findings through clear visualizations, dashboards, and narratives tailored to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike
Collaborate with data engineers on data availability and quality, and with ML/AI engineers to move models from notebook to production
Monitor deployed models for drift and degradation, and own the retraining and improvement cycle


Requirements


At least 4 years in data science or applied analytics, with models and analyses that made it past the prototype stage
Strong Python skills across the standard data stack (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn)
Solid statistical foundations: hypothesis testing, regression, experimental design, and knowing when a result is real versus noise
Knowledge of at least one cloud/data platform and its data science components — Azure (Microsoft Fabric, Azure Machine Learning), AWS (SageMaker), GCP (Vertex AI, BigQuery ML), Snowflake (Snowpark ML, Cortex), Databricks (MLflow, Mosaic AI), or Palantir (Foundry Code Workspaces, Foundry ML, AIP)
Ability to communicate analytical results clearly to business stakeholders and influence decisions with data
Familiarity with working autonomously while collaborating effectively with data engineers, architects, and product teams
Fluent English, both written and spoken
Fluent Polish required
Residing in Poland required


Nice to have


Production experience with Microsoft Fabric or Palantir Foundry certification (Foundry Data Engineer / Data Scientist tracks)
Experience with time series forecasting, NLP, recommender systems, or exposure to LLM-based workflows
Familiarity with MLOps practices: MLflow, experiment tracking, model versioning, and CI/CD for ML
Experience with Power BI or other BI tools, and distributed processing with Spark/PySpark
